timeline.summary: At the Corthipan Inlet Caliphear finds the Torrent blocked and meets Altair, whose enchantment redirects her magic; they ally for ten years of his service.
timeline.quote: In exchange for her help, Altair offers her ten years of service. Caliphear accepts.
